segments.1TH.1.1-1: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy greet the church
segments.1TH.1.2-3: Paul thanks God for the believers’ faith, love, and hope
segments.1TH.1.4-5: Paul knows God chose them; the gospel came with power
segments.1TH.1.6-7: The Thessalonians followed Paul and became an example
segments.1TH.1.8-10: Everyone hears how the Thessalonians turned to God
segments.1TH.2.1-2: Paul spoke the gospel boldly in spite of suffering
segments.1TH.2.3-4: Paul’s message came from God, not from trickery
segments.1TH.2.5-6: Paul never flattered them or sought praise
segments.1TH.2.7-9: Paul cared for them like a mother and worked hard
segments.1TH.2.10-12: Paul acted like a father to each of them
segments.1TH.2.13-13: The Thessalonians accepted the message as God’s word
segments.1TH.2.14-16: The Thessalonians suffer as the Judean churches did
segments.1TH.3.1-3: Paul sent Timothy from Athens to strengthen them
segments.1TH.3.4-5: Paul feared the tempter had made his work useless
segments.1TH.3.6-7: Timothy brings good news about their faith and love
segments.1TH.3.8-10: Paul thanks God and prays to see them again
segments.1TH.3.11-13: Paul prays to visit them and that their love grows
segments.1TH.4.1-2: Paul urges believers to live to please God
segments.1TH.4.3-6: God wants believers to be holy and avoid sexual sin
segments.1TH.4.7-8: God called believers to holiness, not impurity
segments.1TH.4.9-12: Paul urges believers to love more and work quietly
segments.1TH.4.16-18: The Lord will come, and believers will meet him
segments.1TH.5.1-3: The Day of the Lord will come suddenly
segments.1TH.5.4-7: Believers belong to the day and must stay alert
segments.1TH.5.8-11: God has appointed believers to salvation, not wrath
segments.1TH.5.12-14: Paul urges believers to respect leaders and help the weak
segments.1TH.5.15-18: Believers should do good, rejoice, pray, and give thanks
segments.1TH.5.19-22: Believers must test everything and hold to what is good
segments.1TH.5.23-24: Paul prays that God will keep them blameless
segments.1TH.5.25-28: Paul asks them to pray and to read this letter to all
